newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's A.Silva, Somague seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's A.Silva, Somague seen rising.

text.p: Shares of Portuguese construction companies Somague and A.Silva e Silva were expected to rise at the opening on Lisbon bourse after news the firms had held talks over a possible exchange of shares, dealers said.
"Somague would become the biggest Portuguese constructor and A.Silva e Silva would receive funds to pay its debts -- both these factors could help the share prices," said one dealer.
The Financial Markets Committee (CMVM) approved a resumption of trade in the two stocks today after their suspension yesterday.

Another operator said: "If the deal (purchase of A.Silva e Silva's Assiconstroi by Somague) costs 11 or 12 billion escudos as the press says, it would be a good deal for Somague and its share price should rise."
Shares of A.Silva e Silva closed on Lisbon bourse on Tuesday at 1,740 escudos and Somague closed at 2,100 escudos.
